# @aponiajs/idempotency

> `Idempotency-Key` deduplication, in-flight conflict protection, payload mismatch detection, and response replay for an AponiaJS application.

## What this package exports

- `IdempotencyModule.forRoot(options?)` and `IdempotencyModule.forRootAsync(options)`
- `MemoryIdempotencyStore`: bounded process-local store
- `IdempotencyStore`, `MODULE_OPTIONS_TOKEN`, `IDEMPOTENCY_STORE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_OPTIONS`
